'''Brandon Allen Asteroid Sanctuary''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Brandon Allen]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-7355">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7355 Asteroid Sanctuary], DeckTech (Brandon "Sundevil" Allen, 9 June 2000).
